name: Druk White Lotus School (3 Idiots School)
description: Solar-powered school featured in Bollywood's "3 Idiots". Innovative mud-brick architecture.

name: Hall of Fame Museum
description: Indian Army museum documenting the history of warfare in Ladakh.

name: Hemis Monastery
description: Largest and wealthiest monastery in Ladakh. Famous for annual Hemis Festival with masked dances.

name: Khardung La
description: One of the world's highest motorable passes at 17,582 ft. Gateway to Nubra Valley. Iconic photo point.

name: Leh Main Bazaar
description: Central market with Tibetan jewellery, pashmina shawls, and thangka paintings.

name: Leh Palace
description: Nine-storey former royal palace modelled after the Potala Palace in Lhasa.

name: Magnetic Hill
description: Optical illusion where vehicles appear to roll uphill against gravity. Popular roadside attraction.

name: Shanti Stupa
description: White-domed Buddhist stupa overlooking Leh town. Best at sunrise and sunset.

name: Spituk Monastery
description: Founded in 11th century on a hillock overlooking the Indus Valley. Views of Leh and Stok Kangri.

name: Thiksey Monastery
description: Spectacular 12-story monastery resembling the Potala Palace in Lhasa. 15-meter Maitreya Buddha statue.

name: Zanskar-Indus Confluence
description: Dramatic confluence where turquoise Zanskar meets muddy Indus. Stunning color contrast visible from the road.

name: Bodhi Tree
description: Direct descendant of the original tree under which Buddha attained enlightenment 2,500+ years ago.

name: Dungeshwari Cave Temples (Sujata Temple)
description: Cave where Buddha practiced extreme austerities before enlightenment. Sujata Stupa marks where he was offered rice milk.

name: Great Buddha Statue
description: 80-ft seated Buddha statue unveiled by the Dalai Lama. Surrounded by 10 smaller Buddhas in garden.

name: International Monasteries
description: Monasteries from 25+ countries (Japan, Thailand, Bhutan, Nepal) each in their own architectural style.

name: Mahabodhi Temple
description: UNESCO World Heritage temple marking where Buddha attained enlightenment. Bodhi Tree descendant still stands.

name: Bhojbasa Forest Camp
description: Forest camp at 3,780m between Gangotri and Gaumukh. Popular overnight halt on the trek with basic dhabas.

name: Gangotri Main Temple
description: Sacred temple at 3,100m marking the source of the Ganga River. Steep stone steps lead up to the inner sanctum.

name: Gangotri Temple
description: Source of the holy Ganges at 10,200 ft. 18th-century white granite temple. Char Dham pilgrimage site.

name: Gaumukh Glacier
description: Snout of the Gangotri Glacier — actual source of the Ganges. 18 km trek from Gangotri at 12,769 ft.

name: Apatani Tribal Villages
description: Traditional Apatani settlements like Hong Village. Unique culture with nose plugs and facial tattoos (elderly women).

name: Pine Forest Canopy Walk
description: Dense pine and rhododendron forest walks. Bird-watching spot. Paths through sacred groves.

name: Ziro Music Festival Grounds
description: India's premier outdoor music festival held every September amidst rice paddies and pine forests.

name: Ziro Paddy Fields
description: UNESCO Tentative List cultural landscape. Stunning terraced rice paddies of the Apatani tribe.

name: Deolo Hill
description: Highest point in Kalimpong at 5,580 ft with panoramic views of the Teesta Valley and Kanchenjunga.

name: Durpin Dara (Zang Dhok Palri)
description: Hilltop Buddhist monastery modeled on the Heavenly Palace of Guru Padmasambhava.

name: Kalimpong Flower Nurseries
description: Famous orchid and gladioli nurseries. Over 50 varieties of orchids and hundreds of cacti species.

name: Kangra Tea Gardens
description: Lush tea plantations producing the world-famous Kangra tea. Walking trails through manicured gardens.

name: Neugal Khad
description: Scenic gorge with a river and an iron bridge offering views of Dhauladhar mountains.

name: Tashi Jong Monastery
description: Tibetan Buddhist monastery and arts center. Home to traditional thangka painting and mask-making schools.

name: Donyi Polo Temple
description: The main temple of the Donyi-Polo religion — an indigenous animist belief system of the Galo and neighbouring tribes centred on Sun (Donyi) and Moon (Polo). Active worship with traditional rituals on full-moon days.

name: Yomgo River & Confluence
description: Aalo sits at the confluence of the Yomgo and Siyom rivers. Walk along the bamboo suspension bridge for a classic Siang-region frame. Sunset here is the town's signature moment.

name: Ambaji Temple
description: One of 51 Shakti Peethas. No idol — worship is of the Shri Visa Yantra. Massive Navratri gatherings.

name: Gabbar Hill
description: Hilltop with Aravalli views. Temple at summit. Ropeway available or 300-step climb.

name: Dibang River suspension bridge
description: The access bridge to Dambuk across the Dibang's braided channels — 4WD-only crossing for most of the year. Photogenic at dawn when valley mist rises through the bridge deck.

name: Orange orchards
description: Rolling citrus farms that give Dambuk its identity — peak fruit is Nov-Dec, which aligns with the Orange Festival. Several farms welcome visitors and sell direct.

name: Charang La Pass
description: The 5,242m crossing at the top of the parikrama, between Charang and Chitkul valleys. Snowbound till early August in most years.

name: Kinner Kailash Shivling
description: A 79-foot vertical rock formation revered as a natural Shiva lingam, sitting just below the Kinner Kailash peak. The colour appears to shift across the day as the light angle changes.

name: Chauli Ki Jali
description: Rock formation with natural holes through which you can see the valley below. Rappelling point.

name: Mukteshwar Temple
description: Shiva temple at 7,500 ft perched on a cliff edge with chauti ki jali (rock overhang for adventure).

name: Pandupol Temple
description: Cave temple of Hanuman inside the tiger reserve. Believed to be where Pandavas hid during exile.

name: Sariska Tiger Safari
description: Tiger reserve in the Aravalli Hills. First to successfully relocate tigers. Jeep safaris available.

name: Dubdi Monastery
description: Oldest monastery in Sikkim (1701). 45-minute uphill trek through forest. Peaceful and remote.

name: Norbugang Coronation Throne
description: Historic site where the first Chogyal (king) of Sikkim was crowned in 1642 by three revered lamas.

name: Likir Monastery
description: 11th-century monastery with a 25-meter gold-covered Maitreya Buddha statue visible for miles.

name: Ranakpur Jain Temple
description: 15th-century Chaumukha Temple with 1,444 uniquely carved marble pillars — no two alike. Jain architecture masterpiece.
